subject: Pricing follow-up: post-demo token run-rate and invoice sketch
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: post-demo token run-rate and invoice sketch

Hi Natalie — great demo earlier, thanks for the time. As promised, here’s a short post-call recap focused on pricing and next steps so your procurement and finance teams have material to review. I attached a compact pricing calculator and a raw token-runway CSV with the usage profile you shared.

Summary (short):
- Pilot profile we discussed: 2M tokens/day peak (inbound+responses), average 0.6M tokens/day first month with ramp to 1.8M by month 3.
- Proposed starter pricing (pilot): $1,000 per 1M tokens for first 90 days (includes priority routing + 48hr support SLA).
- Long-run target unit at scale (annual commitment): $700 per 1M tokens with batching & prefix KV cache enabled; further discounts available for reserved capacity.
- Estimated monthly invoice (scenario A — mid ramp): ~$34k/month (calculator attached).

Key assumptions included in the attached calculator: tokenization on average 1.3 tokens/word, 65% cache hit on repeated prefixes after canonicalization, 256-token response average, and a 3x burst headroom buffer for spikes. Please review cells highlighted in yellow — those are knobs we can tune with your engineering team.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Finance: review attached estimate and confirm target $/1M token range that is acceptable for a 3‑month pilot.
2) Engineering: confirm whether 65% cache hit is realistic for your flows; if lower, unit cost will be ~10–15% higher.
3) Commercial: if the pilot is acceptable, I’ll generate a one-page quote and a DocuSign link for your procurement team by EOD Thursday.

Attachments: helix_pricing_calculator_v1.xlsx (pricing tabs + sensitivity), token_runway_scenario_A.csv (raw sample distribution)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call with finance if helpful.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0139

From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@helixhealth.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Helix Health Finance <finance@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: post-demo token run-rate and invoice sketch

Thanks, Laura — appreciate the clear recap and the attachments. A couple quick clarifying Qs from our side before we pass to procurement: 

- Can you confirm a simple line item we can put in the budget: "Platform usage @ $X per 1M tokens" (we're trying to compare to other line items). We need a single number for initial approval, even if it changes after the pilot.
- For the June->Sept pilot we can target a range of 0.5M–2.0M tokens/day; our preferred budget band is ~$30k–$45k/month. Will the starter pricing you listed keep us inside that band during ramp?

If you can reply with that single budget-line price and a brief note about how usage bands affect the estimate, we’ll move it to our procurement queue. Happy to do a 15m call with Marcus this afternoon if needed.

—Natalie
Director, Product Integrations | Helix Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: post-demo token run-rate and invoice sketch

Hi Natalie — quick answer to your ask for a single budget line: for initial procurement we suggest listing: "Redwood Inference platform usage — $1,000 per 1M tokens (pilot rate)". That maps to ~ $30–$40k/month across the 0.5–2.0M/day band depending on exact ramp shape.

A few concrete notes so procurement understands variance:
- If your daily average stays near 0.6M/day, you should expect about $18–22k/month (pilot rate) after accounting for weekend dip and caching.
- If you hit sustained 1.5–2.0M/day with current prompt lengths, we're in the ~$40–$60k/month range at pilot rate; switching to reserved capacity at the long-run rate ($700/1M) reduces that to roughly $28–$40k/month.
- The attached calculator (Drive link included) has a toggle for "reserved vs hosted" and shows net savings with a 12-month commit.

I pushed an eye-readable breakdown into the Drive folder (link below) — open the "runway_summary" tab and you'll see the single-line value in cell B3.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_helix-pricing

If procurement wants a 1‑page quote, Laura will send the DocuSign-ready PDF; otherwise we can iteratively adjust the cells. Marcus
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
